note: A hand-curated list of independent writers covering the war. It is not exhaustive and inclusion is not endorsement. Suggestions and corrections: ukrainianwebsite@bugg.club

blogs.name: An Alaskan in Ukraine
blogs.author: Mark Hayward
blogs.blurb: Dispatches from Ukraine by an Alaskan army veteran turned aid volunteer, much of it centred on the Kherson area.

blogs.name: Kherson Weekly
blogs.author: Brendan Kelley
blogs.blurb: A weekly review of military and civilian events in and around Kherson — shelling, drone attacks, casualties, occupation news.

blogs.name: The Counteroffensive with Tim Mak
blogs.author: Tim Mak
blogs.blurb: A war correspondent's open notebook: human-scale stories from the front, reported from Kyiv by a small independent newsroom.

blogs.name: THE WIRE TAP
blogs.author: Chris Sampson
blogs.blurb: A Kyiv-based journalist and photographer on frontline life, military reform, national security and information warfare.

blogs.name: Svitlana's Wartime Scribbles
blogs.author: Svitlana Iukhymovych
blogs.blurb: An unfiltered civilian diary from Kyiv — air raids, blackouts, grief, dark humour and the routines people build around uncertainty.

blogs.name: Dust and Echoes
blogs.author: Tom Mutch
blogs.blurb: Frontline reporting and analysis from a New Zealand journalist who has covered Ukraine since 2022; author of 'The Dogs of Mariupol'.

blogs.name: abdymok
blogs.author: abdymok
blogs.blurb: A terse day-by-day war diary, numbered by day of the full-scale invasion, from a long-running Ukraine observer.

blogs.name: Futura Doctrina
blogs.author: Mick Ryan
blogs.blurb: Weekly military analysis of the war and its lessons by a retired Australian major general.

blogs.name: Phillips's Newsletter
blogs.author: Phillips P. O'Brien
blogs.blurb: Strategic-studies analysis of the war and Western policy from a professor at the University of St Andrews.
